settings.server_url.label: Amaranth server URL
settings.server_url.description: e.g. https://gw.example.com — sync is off while this is empty.
settings.auth_method.label: Sign-in method
settings.auth_method.description: ID/password signs in with the password stored in your keyring; browser cookies reuse your browser's session.
settings.login_id.label: Login ID
settings.login_id.description: Store the password in your keyring with secret-tool (see README).
settings.browser.label: Browser
settings.browser.description: The browser you are signed in to Amaranth with
settings.browser_profile.label: Browser profile
settings.browser_profile.description: Leave empty for the default profile. e.g. Default, Profile 1, xyz.default-release
settings.only_mine.label: Only my events
settings.only_mine.description: On: only events you take part in. Off: every event in the calendars you can see.
settings.refresh_minutes.label: Sync interval (minutes)
settings.refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch events from Amaranth
settings.past_days.label: Range: days back
settings.past_days.description: How many days before today to sync
settings.future_days.label: Range: days ahead
settings.future_days.description: How many days after today to sync
settings.server_utc_offset.label: Server time zone (UTC+N)
settings.server_utc_offset.description: Time zone of the Amaranth server. Korea is 9.
settings.vdir_path.label: Event folder (vdir)
settings.vdir_path.description: Use a folder dedicated to this plugin (do not share it with other calendars). Must match the path of your [calendar.account.*] entry in the noctalia config.
notify.need_server_body: Enter the server URL (e.g. https://gw.example.com) in the plugin settings to start syncing.
notify.need_calendar_body: In Settings → Calendar, enable the calendar and add a vdir account with this path:
notify.need_python_body: Amaranth sync runs with python3 — install python3 from your distribution.
